title: Launcher: Founder's First Week folds into Setup as a Personal group

source.ref: Owner ruling 2026-10-29: fold Founder's First Week into Setup as a Personal group

detail: After Publish the Setup list ends with a Personal group built from the same six Founder tasks and the same done signals (lib/onboarding/founder-tasks.ts), so there is one list and one set of numbers. The /founder page and its reward are unchanged. Still open: people with no Space have no launch row, so the Finish setup pill does not show for a personal-only path.

verify.evidence: The Setup inventory appends the Personal group from getFounderTasks.
